title: StairwayToHeavenReadingSeminar
author: Hanzhen Bao
quote: To Be a Rock and not to roll
introduction: I hope to pursue research in geometry and topology.

However, my university does not regularly offer graduate-level courses in algebraic topology, differentiable manifolds, Riemannian geometry, or homological algebra. This reading program is an effort to help fill that gap. For each subject, I undertake a one-on-one reading seminar with a faculty mentor, working through assigned readings and giving regular presentations. This website serves as a place to collect and share the notes developed through these seminars. It also brings together notes on topics that spark my interest at conferences, as well as course notes and related materials.

entries.speaker: BaoHanzhen
entries.title: Covering maps
entries.abstract: This sample session introduces covering maps through evenly covered neighborhoods and the familiar covering of the circle by the real line. We discuss path lifting, the relationship with the fundamental group, and a selection of basic examples. The attached draft serves as a sample of the notes that will accompany each reading seminar.

entries.speaker: Y-B
entries.title: Differential Topology 1
entries.abstract: Smooth Manifolds; Tangent Spaces and Tangent Maps; Inverse Function and Constant Rank Theorems; Regular Values and Sard’s Theorem; Submanifolds; Tubular Neighborhoods; Cup Product and Intersection; Transversality.

entries.speaker: Y-B
entries.title: Differential Topology 2
entries.abstract: Vector fields; Time-dependent vector fields and isotopies; Moser’s trick; Flows; Introduction to Morse theory; Handle decomposition; Morse homology; Stable and unstable manifolds; Morse–Smale condition and moduli space; Poincaré duality; Lie derivative; Chern–Weil theory; Smooth structures on spheres and the Poincaré conjecture.

entries.speaker: Y-B
entries.title: Differential Topology 3
entries.abstract: Tensors; Wedge product; Differential forms and pullback; Exterior derivative; de Rham cohomology; Lie derivative; Connections; Hopf invariant; Volume-preserving flows; Degree of a map and local orientation; Orientation; Integration; Counting.

entries.speaker: Y-B
entries.title: Riemannian Geometry 1
entries.abstract: Course outline; Riemannian metrics; Connections and the Levi–Civita connection; Geodesics; Exponential map; Curvature and Jacobi fields; Curvature contractions; Curvature and topology; Complex manifolds and almost complex structures; Complexified tangent and cotangent bundles; Differential forms and Dolbeault cohomology; Hermitian and Kähler metrics; Examples and the canonical bundle; Hodge theory and Kodaira theorems.

entries.speaker: Y-B
entries.title: Riemannian Geometry 2
entries.abstract: Levi–Civita connection and Riemann curvature; Ricci, scalar and sectional curvature; Curvature in dimension three and Einstein manifolds; Covariant derivatives of tensors; Gradient; Commutation of covariant derivatives; Second Bianchi identity; An Einstein condition; Hessian and Laplacian; Bochner formula for functions; The Laplacian on a closed manifold; The first eigenvalue estimate; Divergence of a vector field; Isometry group and Killing vector fields; Bochner formula for Killing fields; Consequences for the isometry group; Harmonic one-forms and Ricci solitons.

entries.speaker: B
entries.title: Supplement 1
entries.abstract: Connections and their arguments; Existence of connections; The Levi–Civita connection; Koszul formula and orthonormal frames; Induced metrics and connections; Covariant derivatives along curves; Parallel fields and parallel transport; Metric compatibility and parallel transport.

entries.speaker: B
entries.title: Supplement 2
entries.abstract: Covariant derivatives along curves; Geodesics; Exponential map; Riemann curvature tensor; Jacobi fields; The do Carmo convention and curvature identities; Curvature components; Sectional curvature; Constant sectional curvature; Ricci and scalar curvature; Coordinate expressions and traces.
